releases.name: SpeedTools v1.2.1
releases.body: - Fix to angler fish locations when using save states (thanks to MDJ287)
releases.bodyZh: - 修复使用存档状态时鱼钩鱼的位置 (感谢 MDJ287)

releases.name: SpeedTools v1.2.0
releases.body:
- New menu format that separates the basics from the more advanced settings
- Better error reporting now outputs some frequent config issues to the console
- Sate is reset on death so unlimited fuel and supernova freeze no longer persist
- Tree locator updated to remove collision and disappear once forest goes dark
- New **Experimental** Bramble Navigation state to practice outrunning anglers
- Fixed float parsing to no longer be dependent on system settings
releases.bodyZh:
- 新菜单格式，将基础设置与更高级的设置分开
- 现在更好的错误报告会将一些常见的配置问题输出到控制台
- 死亡时状态会重置，因此无限燃料和超新星冻结不再持续
- 树木定位器已更新，移除碰撞并在森林变暗时消失
- 新的 **实验性** 黑棘星导航状态，用于练习躲避捕鱼者
- 修复了浮点数解析，不再依赖于系统设置

releases.name: SpeedTools v1.1.0
releases.body:
- Ship now reliably wedged in archway for Bramble Entry practice
- Changed default keybind for Statue Skip so it doesn't use a key that is also used with the scout
- Added experimental Stranger practice state
releases.bodyZh:
- 舰船现在可靠地卡在拱门中，用于黑棘星入口练习
- 更改了默认的雕像跳过键位绑定，使其不使用与侦察兵也使用的键位
- 添加了实验性的陌生人练习状态
